criterion: Writes a plan file under docs/plans/ (active or completed/) specifying deterministic subject bucketing and automatic error-rate rollback.
Implements deterministic SHA-256 bucketing in FlagController.evaluate(flag_key, subject_id) so the same (flag_key, subject_id) pair consistently maps to [0, 100) and respects rollout_pct.
Tracks sample count and error count in record_outcome(flag_key, error_occurred) and automatically disables the flag when sample_count >= min_samples and error_rate > max_error_rate.
Adds unit tests under tests/ covering 0%/100%/partial rollout stability, below-min_samples immunity, and automatic rollback when the error threshold is breached.
All unit tests under tests/ pass when run with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
